proof.r:
# Proof, R side for ecme(). Runs the installed pan 2.0 ecme() on the fixed fixture for
# five cases and writes the results and the timings for ecme_py.py to compare.
#
# Usage:  PAN_RLIB=/tmp/pan_rlib Rscript packages/pan/proof/ecme_r.R
# Cases: A univariate, no vmax; B univariate, vmax; C random intercept and time with
# random.effects; D random intercept and time, vmax; E random intercept and time, start.
# Each case: one untimed call, then the median of 20 timed calls (Sys.time()).

lib <- Sys.getenv("PAN_RLIB", "/tmp/pan_rlib")
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(pan, lib.loc = lib))
stopifnot(as.character(packageVersion("pan", lib.loc = lib)) == "2.0")

script_arg <- grep("^--file=", commandArgs(FALSE), value = TRUE)
here <- dirname(normalizePath(sub("^--file=", "", script_arg)))
fx <- file.path(here, "fixture")
out_dir <- normalizePath(file.path(here, "..", "docs", "output"), mustWork = FALSE)
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

subj <- as.integer(scan(file.path(fx, "subj.csv"), what = integer(), quiet = TRUE))
pred <- as.matrix(read.csv(file.path(fx, "pred.csv"), header = FALSE))
y <- scan(file.path(fx, "ecme_y.csv"), what = double(), quiet = TRUE)
occ <- as.integer(scan(file.path(fx, "ecme_occ.csv"), what = integer(), quiet = TRUE))
vmax <- as.matrix(read.csv(file.path(fx, "ecme_vmax.csv"), header = FALSE))

xcol <- 1:3
zcol <- 1:2
start <- list(beta = c(1.0, 0.5, 0.3), sigma2 = 1, psi = matrix(c(0.5, 0.1, 0.1, 0.5), 2, 2))

cases <- list(
  A = function() ecme(y, subj, occ, pred, xcol, zcol = NULL),
  B = function() ecme(y, subj, occ, pred, xcol, zcol = NULL, vmax = vmax),
  C = function() ecme(y, subj, occ, pred, xcol, zcol = zcol, random.effects = TRUE),
  D = function() ecme(y, subj, occ, pred, xcol, zcol = zcol, vmax = vmax),
  E = function() ecme(y, subj, occ, pred, xcol, zcol = zcol, start = start)
)

items <- c("beta", "sigma2", "psi", "converged", "iter", "loglik", "cov.beta", "bhat", "cov.b")
con <- file(file.path(out_dir, "r_ecme.txt"), "w")
medians <- numeric(length(cases))
names(medians) <- names(cases)

# The zcol = NULL branch of pan 2.0 calls prelim with zcol = 0, so mmu reads pred(., 0),
# which is memory before pred. In some runs that value is NaN and .Fortran stops with
# "NA/NaN/Inf in foreign function call". The value is never used by nopsi, so a call
# that fails is retried until one succeeds. The number of attempts is written.
attempts <- integer(length(cases))
names(attempts) <- names(cases)
run_once <- function(f) {
  # Returns the value of f() or NULL when the call stops on an error.
  val <- NULL
  ok <- tryCatch({ invisible(capture.output(val <- f())); TRUE }, error = function(e) FALSE)
  if (ok) val else NULL
}

for (case in names(cases)) {
  f <- cases[[case]]
  res <- NULL
  a <- 0L
  while (is.null(res) && a < 200L) {
    a <- a + 1L
    res <- run_once(f)
  }
  if (is.null(res)) stop(sprintf("ecme case %s failed 200 times", case))
  attempts[case] <- a
  times <- numeric(20)
  for (k in seq_len(20)) {
    el <- NA_real_
    while (is.na(el)) {
      t0 <- Sys.time()
      v <- run_once(f)
      if (!is.null(v)) el <- as.numeric(Sys.time() - t0, units = "secs")
    }
    times[k] <- el
  }
  medians[case] <- median(times)
  cat(sprintf("CASE %s\n", case), file = con)
  cat(sprintf("ATTEMPTS %d\n", a), file = con)
  for (nm in items) {
    x <- res[[nm]]
    if (is.null(x)) {
      cat(sprintf("NULL %s\n", nm), file = con)
      next
    }
    x <- as.numeric(x)
    d <- dim(res[[nm]])
    if (is.null(d)) d <- length(x)
    cat(sprintf("BLOCK %s %s\n", nm, paste(d, collapse = ",")), file = con)
    cat(sprintf("%.17g\n", x), file = con, sep = "")
  }
  cat(sprintf("TIMES %s\n", paste(sprintf("%.9g", times), collapse = " ")), file = con)
  cat(sprintf("MEDIAN %.9g\n", median(times)), file = con)
}
close(con)

cat(sprintf("R ecme (pan %s) medians of 20 (s): %s\n", as.character(packageVersion("pan", lib.loc = lib)),
            paste(sprintf("%s=%.6f", names(medians), medians), collapse = " ")))
proof.python:
"""Proof, Python side for ecme(). Runs packages/pan/pan/ecme.py on the five cases of
ecme_r.R, times them, and compares every output with the R output in
docs/output/r_ecme.txt.

Usage (run ecme_r.R first):
    python3 packages/pan/proof/ecme_py.py

Each case: one untimed call, then the median of 20 timed calls (time.perf_counter()).
The headline ecme time is the sum of the five case medians, for R and for Python.
"""

import statistics
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
PKG = HERE.parent  # packages/pan, which holds the pan/ package
FIX = HERE / "fixture"
OUT = HERE.parent / "docs" / "output"
sys.path.insert(0, str(PKG))

from pan.ecme import ecme  # noqa: E402

TOL = 1e-8
ITEMS = ["beta", "sigma2", "psi", "converged", "iter", "loglik", "cov.beta", "bhat", "cov.b"]
KEY = {"cov.beta": "cov_beta", "cov.b": "cov_b"}


def load_inputs():
    subj = np.loadtxt(FIX / "subj.csv", dtype=np.int64, ndmin=1)
    pred = np.loadtxt(FIX / "pred.csv", delimiter=",", ndmin=2)
    y = np.loadtxt(FIX / "ecme_y.csv", ndmin=1)
    occ = np.loadtxt(FIX / "ecme_occ.csv", dtype=np.int64, ndmin=1)
    vmax = np.loadtxt(FIX / "ecme_vmax.csv", delimiter=",", ndmin=2)
    return subj, pred, y, occ, vmax


def read_r(path):
    """Parses ecme_r.R output into {case: {"items": {name: None | (dims, values)}, "median": s}}."""
    res = {}
    case = None
    lines = path.read_text().splitlines()
    i = 0
    while i < len(lines):
        parts = lines[i].split()
        tag = parts[0]
        if tag == "CASE":
            case = parts[1]
            res[case] = {"items": {}, "median": None}
            i += 1
        elif tag == "BLOCK":
            name = parts[1]
            dims = tuple(int(d) for d in parts[2].split(","))
            n = int(np.prod(dims))
            vals = np.array([float(v) for v in lines[i + 1 : i + 1 + n]])
            res[case]["items"][name] = (dims, vals)
            i += 1 + n
        elif tag == "NULL":
            res[case]["items"][parts[1]] = None
            i += 1
        elif tag == "MEDIAN":
            res[case]["median"] = float(parts[1])
            i += 1
        else:
            i += 1
    return res


def cases(subj, pred, y, occ, vmax):
    """The five cases, in the same order and with the same arguments as ecme_r.R."""
    base = dict(y=y, subj=subj, occ=occ, pred=pred, xcol=[1, 2, 3])
    start = dict(beta=np.array([1.0, 0.5, 0.3]), sigma2=1.0,
                 psi=np.array([[0.5, 0.1], [0.1, 0.5]]))
    return {
        "A": dict(base, zcol=None),
        "B": dict(base, zcol=None, vmax=vmax),
        "C": dict(base, zcol=[1, 2], random_effects=True),
        "D": dict(base, zcol=[1, 2], vmax=vmax),
        "E": dict(base, zcol=[1, 2], start=start),
    }


def as_flat(value):
    """A Python output as the values R writes: column-major, with its dimensions."""
    arr = np.asarray(value, dtype=float)
    dims = arr.shape if arr.ndim > 0 else (1,)
    return dims, arr.reshape(-1, order="F")


def main():
    subj, pred, y, occ, vmax = load_inputs()
    r_res = read_r(OUT / "r_ecme.txt")
    lines = ["Proof: ecme (Python port of the ECME loop) vs R pan 2.0 ecme on the fixed fixture "
             f"(ntot {y.size}, m {np.unique(subj).size}, tol {TOL:g})"]
    all_ok = True
    py_out = []
    r_total = 0.0
    py_total = 0.0
    for case, kwargs in cases(subj, pred, y, occ, vmax).items():
        out = ecme(**kwargs)  # untimed call
        times = []
        for _ in range(20):
            t0 = time.perf_counter()
            ecme(**kwargs)
            times.append(time.perf_counter() - t0)
        py_med = float(statistics.median(times))
        r_med = r_res[case]["median"]
        r_total += r_med
        py_total += py_med

        case_ok = True
        worst = 0.0
        parts = []
        for name in ITEMS:
            rv = r_res[case]["items"][name]
            pv = out[KEY.get(name, name)]
            if rv is None:
                ok = pv is None
                parts.append(f"{name}=NULL {'ok' if ok else 'MISMATCH'}")
            elif pv is None:
                ok = False
                parts.append(f"{name} MISSING")
            else:
                dims, rvals = rv
                if name == "converged":
                    pv = float(bool(pv))
                pdims, pvals = as_flat(pv)
                if int(np.prod(pdims)) != rvals.size:
                    ok = False
                    diff = float("inf")
                else:
                    diff = float(np.max(np.abs(pvals - rvals))) if rvals.size else 0.0
                    ok = diff <= TOL
                worst = max(worst, diff)
                parts.append(f"{name} max_abs_diff={diff:.3e}")
            case_ok = case_ok and ok
        all_ok = all_ok and case_ok
        lines.append(f"case {case} ({'PASS' if case_ok else 'FAIL'}): " + "; ".join(parts))
        lines.append(f"case {case} R attempts before a clean call: {r_res_attempts(case)}; "
                     f"R median {r_med:.6f} s; Python median {py_med:.6f} s; "
                     f"speedup {r_med / py_med:.2f}")
        py_out.append((case, out, times))

    lines.append(f"Result: {'PASS' if all_ok else 'FAIL'} (tolerance {TOL:g})")
    lines.append(f"ecme total, sum of the five case medians: R {r_total:.6f} s, "
                 f"Python {py_total:.6f} s, speedup (R / Python) = {r_total / py_total:.2f}")
    text = "\n".join(lines) + "\n"
    print(text, end="")
    (OUT / "ecme_compare.txt").write_text(text)

    with open(OUT / "py_ecme.txt", "w") as fh:
        for case, out, times in py_out:
            fh.write(f"CASE {case}\n")
            for name in ITEMS:
                v = out[KEY.get(name, name)]
                if v is None:
                    fh.write(f"NULL {name}\n")
                    continue
                if name == "converged":
                    v = float(bool(v))
                dims, vals = as_flat(v)
                fh.write(f"BLOCK {name} {','.join(str(d) for d in dims)}\n")
                fh.write("".join(f"{x:.17g}\n" for x in vals))
            fh.write("TIMES " + " ".join(f"{t:.9g}" for t in times) + "\n")
            fh.write(f"MEDIAN {statistics.median(times):.9g}\n")

    if not all_ok:
        sys.exit(1)


def r_res_attempts(case):
    text = (OUT / "r_ecme.txt").read_text().splitlines()
    seen = False
    for line in text:
        if line == f"CASE {case}":
            seen = True
        elif seen and line.startswith("ATTEMPTS"):
            return line.split()[1]
    return "?"


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

proof.r:
# Proof, R side. Runs the installed pan 2.0 R functions on the fixed fixture and
# writes the chains and the timings for the Python proof (pan_py.py) to compare.
#
# Usage:  PAN_RLIB=/tmp/pan_rlib Rscript packages/pan/proof/pan_r.R bd
#         PAN_RLIB=/tmp/pan_rlib Rscript packages/pan/proof/pan_r.R full
# "bd" runs pan.bd (mgibbsbd), "full" runs pan (mgibbs). Each kernel runs in its own
# process so the Fortran gauss state starts the same way on both sides.
# pan 2.0 is installed with: R CMD INSTALL -l /tmp/pan_rlib <unpacked pan_2.0.tar.gz>/pan

args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
kernel <- args[1]
stopifnot(kernel %in% c("bd", "full"))

lib <- Sys.getenv("PAN_RLIB", "/tmp/pan_rlib")
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(pan, lib.loc = lib))
stopifnot(as.character(packageVersion("pan", lib.loc = lib)) == "2.0")

script_arg <- grep("^--file=", commandArgs(FALSE), value = TRUE)
here <- dirname(normalizePath(sub("^--file=", "", script_arg)))
fx <- file.path(here, "fixture")
out_dir <- normalizePath(file.path(here, "..", "docs", "output"), mustWork = FALSE)
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

subj <- as.integer(scan(file.path(fx, "subj.csv"), what = integer(), quiet = TRUE))
pred <- as.matrix(read.csv(file.path(fx, "pred.csv"), header = FALSE))
y <- as.matrix(read.csv(file.path(fx, "y.csv"), header = FALSE, na.strings = "NA"))

seed <- 20261017L
iter <- 200L
xcol <- 1:3
zcol <- 1:2
r <- ncol(y)
q <- length(zcol)
rq <- r * q

# Priors: identity scale matrices, a = 3, c = 3. The values are the same as in pan_py.py.
prior_bd <- list(
  a = 3,
  Binv = diag(r),
  c = rep(3, r),
  Dinv = array(c(diag(q), diag(q)), c(q, q, r))
)
prior_full <- list(a = 3, Binv = diag(r), c = 3, Dinv = diag(rq))

run_once <- function() {
  if (kernel == "bd") {
    pan.bd(y, subj, pred, xcol, zcol, prior_bd, seed, iter = iter)
  } else {
    pan(y, subj, pred, xcol, zcol, prior_full, seed, iter = iter)
  }
}

# One untimed call, then the median of 20 timed calls.
chain <- run_once()
times <- numeric(20)
for (k in seq_len(20)) {
  t0 <- Sys.time()
  invisible(run_once())
  times[k] <- as.numeric(Sys.time() - t0, units = "secs")
}

blocks <- list(betas = chain$beta, sigmas = chain$sigma, psis = chain$psi, y = chain$y)
con <- file(file.path(out_dir, paste0("r_", kernel, ".txt")), "w")
for (nm in names(blocks)) {
  x <- blocks[[nm]]
  cat(sprintf("BLOCK %s %s\n", nm, paste(dim(x), collapse = ",")), file = con)
  cat(sprintf("%.17g\n", as.vector(x)), file = con, sep = "")
}
cat(sprintf("TIMES %s\n", paste(sprintf("%.9g", times), collapse = " ")), file = con)
cat(sprintf("MEDIAN %.9g\n", median(times)), file = con)
close(con)

cat(sprintf(
  "R %s (pan %s, Fortran via R): median of 20 = %.6f s; untimed call written to r_%s.txt\n",
  if (kernel == "bd") "pan.bd" else "pan", as.character(packageVersion("pan", lib.loc = lib)),
  median(times), kernel
))
proof.python:
"""Proof, Python side for pan() and pan.bd(). Calls the Python wrappers in
packages/pan/pan/ (pan.py and pan_bd.py) on the fixed fixture, times them, and compares
every chain with the R output that pan_r.R wrote for the same function.

Usage (run pan_r.R with the same argument first):
    python3 packages/pan/proof/pan_py.py bd      # pan.bd (mgibbsbd) vs R pan.bd
    python3 packages/pan/proof/pan_py.py full    # pan (mgibbs) vs R pan

Each call: one untimed call, then the median of 20 timed calls (time.perf_counter()).
The timed call is the whole wrapper: the checks, the index work, rngs, and the kernel.
"""

import statistics
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
PKG = HERE.parent  # packages/pan, which holds the pan/ package
FIX = HERE / "fixture"
OUT = HERE.parent / "docs" / "output"
sys.path.insert(0, str(PKG))

from pan.pan import pan  # noqa: E402
from pan.pan_bd import pan_bd  # noqa: E402

SEED = 20261017
ITER = 200
TOL = 1e-8
XCOL = [1, 2, 3]
ZCOL = [1, 2]


def load_fixture():
    subj = np.loadtxt(FIX / "subj.csv", dtype=np.int64, ndmin=1)
    pred = np.loadtxt(FIX / "pred.csv", delimiter=",", ndmin=2)
    rows = [line.strip().split(",") for line in open(FIX / "y.csv")]
    y = np.array([[np.nan if v == "NA" else float(v) for v in row] for row in rows])
    return subj, pred, y


def read_r_blocks(path):
    blocks, times, median = {}, None, None
    lines = path.read_text().splitlines()
    i = 0
    while i < len(lines):
        parts = lines[i].split()
        if parts[0] == "BLOCK":
            name, dims = parts[1], tuple(int(d) for d in parts[2].split(","))
            n = int(np.prod(dims))
            vals = np.array([float(v) for v in lines[i + 1 : i + 1 + n]])
            blocks[name] = vals.reshape(dims, order="F")
            i += 1 + n
        elif parts[0] == "TIMES":
            times = [float(v) for v in parts[1:]]
            i += 1
        elif parts[0] == "MEDIAN":
            median = float(parts[1])
            i += 1
        else:
            i += 1
    return blocks, times, median


def main():
    kernel = sys.argv[1]
    assert kernel in ("bd", "full")
    subj, pred, y = load_fixture()
    ntot, r = y.shape
    q = len(ZCOL)
    rq = r * q

    if kernel == "bd":
        prior = dict(
            a=3.0,
            Binv=np.eye(r),
            c=np.full(r, 3.0),
            Dinv=np.stack([np.eye(q)] * r, axis=2),  # q x q x r, one block per response
        )
        func, label = pan_bd, "pan.bd (mgibbsbd)"
    else:
        prior = dict(a=3.0, Binv=np.eye(r), c=3.0, Dinv=np.eye(rq))
        func, label = pan, "pan (mgibbs)"

    def one_call():
        return func(y, subj, pred, XCOL, ZCOL, prior, SEED, iter=ITER)

    out = one_call()  # untimed
    times = []
    for _ in range(20):
        t0 = time.perf_counter()
        one_call()
        times.append(time.perf_counter() - t0)
    median_py = float(statistics.median(times))

    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    r_blocks, _, r_median = read_r_blocks(OUT / f"r_{kernel}.txt")
    chain = {"betas": out["beta"], "sigmas": out["sigma"], "psis": out["psi"], "y": out["y"]}
    if r == 1:
        chain["y"] = chain["y"].reshape(-1, 1)
    lines = [f"Proof: {label} wrapper vs R pan 2.0 on the fixed fixture "
             f"(seed {SEED}, iter {ITER}, ntot {ntot}, tol {TOL:g})"]
    max_all = 0.0
    all_ok = True
    for name in ("betas", "sigmas", "psis", "y"):
        rv = r_blocks[name]
        pv = np.asarray(chain[name], dtype=float)
        if rv.shape != pv.shape:
            lines.append(f"{name}: shape mismatch R {rv.shape} vs Python {pv.shape}")
            all_ok = False
            continue
        diff = float(np.max(np.abs(rv - pv)))
        max_all = max(max_all, diff)
        ok = diff <= TOL
        all_ok = all_ok and ok
        lines.append(f"{name:6s} shape={pv.shape} max_abs_diff={diff:.3e} {'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'}")
    lines.append(f"max_abs_diff over all chains = {max_all:.3e}")
    lines.append(f"Result: {'PASS' if all_ok else 'FAIL'} (tolerance {TOL:g})")
    lines.append(f"R median of 20 timed calls (Sys.time): {r_median:.6f} s")
    lines.append(f"Python median of 20 timed calls (perf_counter), wrapper + rngs + kernel: {median_py:.6f} s")
    lines.append(f"speedup (R / Python) = {r_median / median_py:.2f}")
    text = "\n".join(lines) + "\n"
    print(text, end="")
    (OUT / f"{kernel}_compare.txt").write_text(text)

    with open(OUT / f"py_{kernel}.txt", "w") as fh:
        for name in ("betas", "sigmas", "psis", "y"):
            pv = np.asarray(chain[name], dtype=float)
            fh.write(f"BLOCK {name} {','.join(str(d) for d in pv.shape)}\n")
            fh.write("".join(f"{v:.17g}\n" for v in pv.reshape(-1, order="F")))
        fh.write("TIMES " + " ".join(f"{t:.9g}" for t in times) + "\n")
        fh.write(f"MEDIAN {median_py:.9g}\n")

    if not all_ok:
        sys.exit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

proof.python:
"""Proof, Python side for pan() and pan.bd(). Calls the Python wrappers in
packages/pan/pan/ (pan.py and pan_bd.py) on the fixed fixture, times them, and compares
every chain with the R output that pan_r.R wrote for the same function.

Usage (run pan_r.R with the same argument first):
    python3 packages/pan/proof/pan_py.py bd      # pan.bd (mgibbsbd) vs R pan.bd
    python3 packages/pan/proof/pan_py.py full    # pan (mgibbs) vs R pan

Each call: one untimed call, then the median of 20 timed calls (time.perf_counter()).
The timed call is the whole wrapper: the checks, the index work, rngs, and the kernel.
"""

import statistics
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
PKG = HERE.parent  # packages/pan, which holds the pan/ package
FIX = HERE / "fixture"
OUT = HERE.parent / "docs" / "output"
sys.path.insert(0, str(PKG))

from pan.pan import pan  # noqa: E402
from pan.pan_bd import pan_bd  # noqa: E402

SEED = 20261017
ITER = 200
TOL = 1e-8
XCOL = [1, 2, 3]
ZCOL = [1, 2]


def load_fixture():
    subj = np.loadtxt(FIX / "subj.csv", dtype=np.int64, ndmin=1)
    pred = np.loadtxt(FIX / "pred.csv", delimiter=",", ndmin=2)
    rows = [line.strip().split(",") for line in open(FIX / "y.csv")]
    y = np.array([[np.nan if v == "NA" else float(v) for v in row] for row in rows])
    return subj, pred, y


def read_r_blocks(path):
    blocks, times, median = {}, None, None
    lines = path.read_text().splitlines()
    i = 0
    while i < len(lines):
        parts = lines[i].split()
        if parts[0] == "BLOCK":
            name, dims = parts[1], tuple(int(d) for d in parts[2].split(","))
            n = int(np.prod(dims))
            vals = np.array([float(v) for v in lines[i + 1 : i + 1 + n]])
            blocks[name] = vals.reshape(dims, order="F")
            i += 1 + n
        elif parts[0] == "TIMES":
            times = [float(v) for v in parts[1:]]
            i += 1
        elif parts[0] == "MEDIAN":
            median = float(parts[1])
            i += 1
        else:
            i += 1
    return blocks, times, median


def main():
    kernel = sys.argv[1]
    assert kernel in ("bd", "full")
    subj, pred, y = load_fixture()
    ntot, r = y.shape
    q = len(ZCOL)
    rq = r * q

    if kernel == "bd":
        prior = dict(
            a=3.0,
            Binv=np.eye(r),
            c=np.full(r, 3.0),
            Dinv=np.stack([np.eye(q)] * r, axis=2),  # q x q x r, one block per response
        )
        func, label = pan_bd, "pan.bd (mgibbsbd)"
    else:
        prior = dict(a=3.0, Binv=np.eye(r), c=3.0, Dinv=np.eye(rq))
        func, label = pan, "pan (mgibbs)"

    def one_call():
        return func(y, subj, pred, XCOL, ZCOL, prior, SEED, iter=ITER)

    out = one_call()  # untimed
    times = []
    for _ in range(20):
        t0 = time.perf_counter()
        one_call()
        times.append(time.perf_counter() - t0)
    median_py = float(statistics.median(times))

    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    r_blocks, _, r_median = read_r_blocks(OUT / f"r_{kernel}.txt")
    chain = {"betas": out["beta"], "sigmas": out["sigma"], "psis": out["psi"], "y": out["y"]}
    if r == 1:
        chain["y"] = chain["y"].reshape(-1, 1)
    lines = [f"Proof: {label} wrapper vs R pan 2.0 on the fixed fixture "
             f"(seed {SEED}, iter {ITER}, ntot {ntot}, tol {TOL:g})"]
    max_all = 0.0
    all_ok = True
    for name in ("betas", "sigmas", "psis", "y"):
        rv = r_blocks[name]
        pv = np.asarray(chain[name], dtype=float)
        if rv.shape != pv.shape:
            lines.append(f"{name}: shape mismatch R {rv.shape} vs Python {pv.shape}")
            all_ok = False
            continue
        diff = float(np.max(np.abs(rv - pv)))
        max_all = max(max_all, diff)
        ok = diff <= TOL
        all_ok = all_ok and ok
        lines.append(f"{name:6s} shape={pv.shape} max_abs_diff={diff:.3e} {'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'}")
    lines.append(f"max_abs_diff over all chains = {max_all:.3e}")
    lines.append(f"Result: {'PASS' if all_ok else 'FAIL'} (tolerance {TOL:g})")
    lines.append(f"R median of 20 timed calls (Sys.time): {r_median:.6f} s")
    lines.append(f"Python median of 20 timed calls (perf_counter), wrapper + rngs + kernel: {median_py:.6f} s")
    lines.append(f"speedup (R / Python) = {r_median / median_py:.2f}")
    text = "\n".join(lines) + "\n"
    print(text, end="")
    (OUT / f"{kernel}_compare.txt").write_text(text)

    with open(OUT / f"py_{kernel}.txt", "w") as fh:
        for name in ("betas", "sigmas", "psis", "y"):
            pv = np.asarray(chain[name], dtype=float)
            fh.write(f"BLOCK {name} {','.join(str(d) for d in pv.shape)}\n")
            fh.write("".join(f"{v:.17g}\n" for v in pv.reshape(-1, order="F")))
        fh.write("TIMES " + " ".join(f"{t:.9g}" for t in times) + "\n")
        fh.write(f"MEDIAN {median_py:.9g}\n")

    if not all_ok:
        sys.exit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
